title: Wi-Fi router
prompt: a home Wi-Fi router: plug in the WAN cable, power on, LEDs blink as a phone connects and a packet travels from phone to internet; see-through shows the SoC, radios, antennas, Ethernet switch, power supply and the packet path
blurb: Cable it to the modem, boot it, join a phone, then follow one packet from the phone's radio through antenna, radio chip, SoC, switch and WAN port out to the internet.
